tests.note: node --test over 7 files: combat, state, player, RustGrunt, WaveSpawner, arena.sim, optionsData. No test covers scenes, Zed.js (Phaser), or UI scenes.

gameFlow: index.html:15-34 registers scenes [TitleScene, MenuScene, ArenaScene, HudScene, ResultScene]; Phaser 3.80.1 via CDN, 1280x720, arcade physics, gamepad on. TitleScene -> MenuScene(FIGHT) -> ArenaScene (+HudScene overlay) -> ResultScene (pause/win/lose).

features.summary: Zed movement: run, jump with variable height (jump cut), coyote time and jump buffer, gravity. Physics body is a 32x72 rect; art is a separate image. Keys: move A/D/arrows, jump W/Up/Space.
Player state machine (pure, 60fps frame-stepped): idle, run, jump, attack, hitstun, block, dodge. Attack buffer, chain cancel at cancelFrom, finisher/heavy not cancelable, hitstun interrupts.

Zed melee moves (frames at 60fps). light1 -> light2 -> light3 chain; light1/light2 can cancel into heavy1. Light=J/Z, heavy=K/X. No crouch, no pickups, no special/grab moves, no air attacks (airborne forces jump state).
Dodge (V/LeftShift): 24 frames, first 14 are i-frames (guard 'dodge' negates damage, emits damage-applied amount 0), 30-frame cooldown, moves facing * 380 px/s. Only startable from grounded neutral.
tests: src/player/test/player.test.mjs (block parry window then block; dodge i-frames)

features.summary: Block (L/C hold) with parry window: first 8 frames of a fresh block = parry (damage negated, amount 0); afterwards block = damage x0.25 (min 1), knockback x0.25, no hitstun. Parry has no counter or reward (code comment: hp refund needs combat support). Block ignores hitstun.

Hit resolver: listens to entity-registered/unregistered, hit-request, round-won/lost (locks), retry (resets hp). Rect overlap with mirrored hitboxes/hurtboxes, one hit per (attackId,target), team filter, player 400ms i-frames after a hit, damage clamped to remaining hp, emits damage-applied, player-health-changed, entity-died. Knockback direction = away from attacker by x.

Zed Phaser wrapper: registers as 'player' (hurtbox 32x72 centered), emits hit-request every active frame with one attackId per swing, applies hitstun/knockback on damage-applied, dies on entity-died, respawns on retry (position reset, re-register). Zed holds no hp (combat owns it). Hitstun ms to frames via ceil(ms/16.67).

RustGrunt AI (pure): idle(400ms spawn) -> approach -> telegraph -> attack -> recover -> approach; hitstun; dead. Chases in 2D, lines up in the lane, circles when attacker slots are full. Single enemy type only (grunt); no ranged/elite/boss.
Attacker cap: at most ATTACKER_CAP grunts hold an attack slot (telegraph/attack) at once; others circle or back off.

EnemyManager: spawns grunts from wave specs, emits entity-registered, forwards grunt hit-requests to game.events, applies takeHit on damage-applied, die on entity-died, corpse lingers then entity-unregistered, destroyAll on retry.

WaveSpawner: wave table with start delay, spawn interval, maxAlive cap, round-robin spawn points at left/right edges of the locked view; emits wave-started, wave-cleared, arena-cleared; listens entity-died (rust) and retry (restart at wave 1). No inter-wave rest, reward or pickup.

ArenaBounds: world 1920x720, view 1280x720, walkable lane y 460..680, lock margin 40. Camera locks at wave lockX during a wave (player and enemies clamped to the locked screen), released on wave-cleared, otherwise follows the player with lerp 0.12. Player y is pinned to GROUND_Y (640) for the bounds clamp; the player jumps but has no depth-lane (y) movement.
ArenaFailsafe: clamps grunts into bounds each frame; off-screen >2500ms or stuck >4000ms -> teleport to a wave spawn point; after 3 teleports the enemy is removed and counts toward the wave clear.

Round state: countdown timer ticked from scene update; timer-tick each whole second; round-lost timeout at 0, round-lost ko when player dies, round-won cleared on arena-cleared; retry resets timer (MAX_RETRIES Infinity).

ArenaScene integration: creates resolver, round state, Zed, Arena; launches HudScene and starts the round once HUD exists; renders placeholder SVG images for Zed/grunts with tints (hitstun white, block blue, dodge alpha 0.5, telegraph red ramp), shadows, swing-box flashes, spark FX, screen shake on player damage (100ms/0.0023) and finishers (damage>=12: 120ms/0.003). Pause on Esc/P, tab blur, gamepad Start. No hit-stop. Ends round after 700ms then launches ResultScene.

HudScene: ZED label, health bar 360x28 (red under 30%), hp text, WAVE n / total, ENEMIES LEFT, MM:SS timer (red at <=10s), wave banner (FIGHT! / WAVE n), fading Esc: pause hint. Pure event consumer; ignores the Options timer-visibility setting.

ResultScene: pause overlay (Resume / Restart with confirm / Main Menu with confirm), win screen LEVEL CLEARED, lose screens TIME'S UP / KNOCKED OUT with stats (waves cleared, enemies defeated, time remaining, health out of hard-coded 100). Play/Try Again emits retry; Main Menu goes to MenuScene. Keyboard, mouse, gamepad nav.
TitleScene: drawn title screen, loads content/dialogue/title-screen.json with fallbacks, any key/click/pad -> fake 1500ms loading bar with 5 loading lines -> MenuScene. Version string v0.1.

MenuScene (Wheatpaste Wall): strips FIGHT, CONTROLS, OPTIONS, QUIT (quit only shows a toast). FIGHT emits start-game then fades to ArenaScene. Controls panel shows a binding table (Move, Jump, Crouch, Light J/Z, Heavy K/X, Dodge L/C, Pick up P/N, Parry T/M, Block I/V) that does not match the actual KEY_MAP in input.js (real: block=L/C, dodge=Shift/V; no crouch, pickup or separate parry key).

Options: schema, defaults, validation, localStorage persistence (key rebellion.options.v1) plus OptionsPanel UI with Apply, reset, unsaved-changes dialogs. 12 settings. MenuScene loads them, but no gameplay module reads the values (no audio system; ArenaScene shake and HudScene timer ignore them). Control rebinding not implemented.

All art is placeholder SVG. assets/asset-keys.json declares ui bars/buttons/panel/icons, sprites zed + rust.grunt, animation names (zed.idle/walk/jump/light/heavy/hit/ko; rust.grunt.idle/walk/telegraph/attack/hit/ko), bg.arena.01, fx.spark, fx.telegraph, menu art. Code loads only bg.arena.01, zed.visual, rust.grunt, fx.telegraph, fx.spark and menu.* assets. No Phaser animations are created or played (one static image per character). Zed.js spriteKey 'player.zed.placeholder' is not in asset-keys.json. GRUNT_ANIMS table is defined but unused.
GruntTestScene: standalone debug scene for grunt AI, not registered in index.html.
